items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I played with Pritchard Band, them heavy overtures, yeah.

ctx.x: I just wondered if you ever saved that old imperial book.

Oh, it's got a new method now. My grandkids got the book, I wanted to leave it here by his house he got it. I played with Pritchard Band, them heavy overtures, yeah. I read anything. See, before I was back with the swing, I used to like to read, played them reading all you see. Yeah, you see. After I found out Jazz had it, that's the best.
A friend of mine who is dead now from Chicago, I knew him out of Chicago, Baby Dodds, you came from here. I know Baby Dodds. And he started with the imperial method too.
